proof_body:
by
  intro a b c x hab hbc
  rcases abs_cases (x - a) with ⟨h1, h1'⟩ | ⟨h1, h1'⟩ <;>
    rcases abs_cases (x - b) with ⟨h2, h2'⟩ | ⟨h2, h2'⟩ <;>
    rcases abs_cases (x - c) with ⟨h3, h3'⟩ | ⟨h3, h3'⟩ <;>
    rw [h1, h2, h3] <;>
    exact ⟨by linarith, ⟨fun h => by linarith, fun h => by linarith⟩⟩
target_source: ∀ a b c x : ℝ, a ≤ b → b ≤ c → c - a ≤ |x - a| + |x - b| + |x - c| ∧ (|x - a| + |x - b| + |x - c| = c - a ↔ x = b)
